hardware.vram_budget_notes: 4GB tight for 4B Q4 + KV. Prefer num_ctx<=8192 (ideally 4096 for live), keep model loaded, single concurrent gen. Target peak VRAM <3.6GB.

scripted_vs_live_ledger.note: scripted is ~148x faster on same fixture; live currently fails. Root: full LLM multi-step tool loop on 1650 vs deterministic scripted path.

speedup.implication: FAST-first + live purge yields ~100x more useful jobs/hour than live-ledger spam. Target 25+ jobs/h on pure FAST.

quantization_impact.recommendation: Lock Q4_K_M (or explicit Q4_0/Q4_K_S if available). Never Q5+/FP16 on this host.

vram_estimates_4b.Q5_K_M: ~3.5-4.5 GB — risk of OOM or heavy offload

quantization_impact.quality: Q4_K_M typical 3-5% quality drop vs FP16 on general tasks; coding/reasoning more sensitive. Still the only viable point on 4GB.
quantization_impact.speed: Lower quant reduces bandwidth pressure on Turing; primary latency still comes from number of generation steps, not quant alone.
quantization_impact.action: Verify `ollama show qwen3.5:4b` quant; prefer explicit tag if Q4_K_M variant exists. Measure nvidia-smi peak under direct_hard.

vllm_investigation.verdict: NOT primary path for this host (Phase 1)
reasons: GTX 1650 = Turing SM 7.5: supported for GPTQ/AWQ/GGUF/bitsandbytes but FlashAttention-2 requires SM>=8.0 (falls back)
Host is Windows native; vLLM has no official Windows support (WSL2 or community fork required)
4GB VRAM is below comfortable vLLM operating point (engine pre-allocates KV; needs low max_model_len + gpu_memory_utilization~0.7)
Agent tool loops are short, low-concurrency: continuous-batching advantage of vLLM is small vs Ollama/llama.cpp overhead
Integration cost high vs measured gain on this exact hardware
vllm_investigation.when_to_revisit: Cousin hardware (>=8-12GB, Ampere+) or after WSL2 + controlled TTFT/tokens-per-s A/B against current Ollama baseline.
vllm_investigation.keep: Ollama remains the locked runtime for host <=4B.

latency_mitigation_steps.detail: ollama keep_alive high / never unload qwen3.5:4b between jobs. Cold load on 1650 costs seconds.
ETHER_NUM_CTX / num_ctx <= 8192 host-wide; 4096 for any live experiment. KV is the hidden VRAM consumer.
Scripted/direct/tool_runtime before any live. kill_live + live_skip_ticks=36. Residual live pending already purged.
Honest tool order + early terminal on bad tool sequences. Avoid full open-ended agent loops on live until Phase 1D green.
max_steps and per-step timeout for live must fit inside ~60-120s wall before honest path is proven. Continue_on_fail only for measurement.
No parallel model loads or concurrent live jobs on 4GB.
Add to scoreboard / performance_benchmark so quant or backend changes can be scored honestly.
Prefer qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M or equivalent if published; document in .env.example and model_select.

targets.live_ledger_honest_pass: OPEN — Phase 1D gate (blocked until measured honest tool path with is_honest_tool_path_pass)

priority: Cap ETHER_NUM_CTX / num_ctx to 8192 or lower on host profile
Prefer Q4_K_M or Q4_0 quant; avoid higher
Single concurrent generation; no parallel model loads
Tool-runtime path avoids full agent loop when possible
Measure nvidia-smi peak during direct_hard vs live
gpu_memory_optimization.hypothesis: Most of the 148x is inference + KV + tool orchestration overhead; scripted bypasses it entirely. Live honest pass needs tool_order + budget that fits 4GB without OOM/timeout. Quant choice is secondary to number of live generation steps.
